title: Gniazdo hunt
description: A Marauder holds station in the Gniazdo and raids Przystań's shipping lanes. Prove yourself to the Przystań office (standing 0.20) and put it down.

title: Lucidite contract
description: Przystań pays a premium on 500 m³ of lucidite out of the Kuźnica belt. Standing 0.20 required before they hand out the order.
